lines.spoken: Hi, I'm Dr. Davis. Welcome to Turncloud.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Dr. Davis. Welcome to Turncloud.

lines.spoken: In the next few minutes, you'll follow one new patient through a real day at the clinic, from the moment they book their appointment, to the moment they walk out the door.
lines.caption: In the next few minutes, you'll follow one new patient through a real day at the clinic, from the moment they book their appointment, to the moment they walk out the door.

lines.spoken: Before I take you through the treatment room, I'd like you to meet my office manager Autumn, she'll show you how she keeps the front office running.
lines.caption: Before I take you through the treatment room, I'd like you to meet my office manager Autumn, she'll show you how she keeps the front office running.

lines.spoken: Hi, I'm Autumn [upbeat]. You can watch the whole day with us, or choose other areas of the practice.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Autumn. You can watch the whole day with us, or choose other areas of the practice.
lines.tip: Pick a path, or press Start for the whole day.

lines.spoken: This is Jordan [happy] She found us online and clicked book now on our website.
lines.caption: This is Jordan. She found us online and clicked book now on our website.

lines.spoken: [Upbeat] Jordan picks the visit, the doctor, and a time that works straight from our real schedule.
lines.caption: Jordan picks the visit, the doctor, and a time that works straight from our real schedule.

lines.spoken: That's a confirmed appointment, not a request. It's on our calendar the second Jordan clicks. [Proud]
lines.caption: That's a confirmed appointment, not a request. It's on our calendar the second Jordan clicks.

lines.spoken: [Happy] You decide which visit types patients can book online versus at the office. [Happy]
lines.caption: You decide which visit types patients can book online versus at the office.

lines.spoken: When paired with our Telnyx integration, Turncloud sends a text message to Jordan with a link to fill out the new-patient paperwork from home. [Happy]
lines.caption: When paired with our Telnyx integration, Turncloud sends a text message to Jordan with a link to fill out the new-patient paperwork from home.

lines.spoken: And when a patient texts back, it comes right to us. [Amazed]
lines.caption: And when a patient texts back, it comes right to us.

lines.spoken: [joyful] I reply directly from Turncloud. No personal cell phones, and no missed messages.
lines.caption: I reply directly from Turncloud. No personal cell phones, and no missed messages.
lines.tip: Reminders plus real two-way texting, built in.

lines.spoken: [Grateful] Jordan filled everything out at home last night: history, insurance, and signed consent forms!
lines.caption: Jordan filled everything out at home last night: history, insurance, and signed consent forms!

lines.spoken: [impressed] When Jordan walks in, I check her in and import the paperwork with a few easy steps.
lines.caption: When Jordan walks in, I check her in and import the paperwork with a few easy steps.

lines.spoken: No clipboard. No retyping. Jordan's chart is ready, and Dr. Davis's first exam note is already started [Impressed]
lines.caption: No clipboard. No retyping. Jordan's chart is ready, and Dr. Davis's first exam note is already started.
lines.tip: Intake flows straight into the chart.

lines.spoken: [Neutral] Didn't get to the paperwork at home? [Happy] Patients can finish it on a tablet in the lobby, and it lands in the chart the same way.
lines.caption: Didn't get to the paperwork at home? Patients can finish it on a tablet in the lobby, and it lands in the chart the same way.

lines.spoken: Here's our whole day. Every doctor gets a column, and you can set it up by room, too!
lines.caption: Here's our whole day. Every doctor gets a column, and you can set it up by room, too!

lines.spoken: [Optimistic] Appointment types and statuses are color-coded, so I can read the day at a glance [Impressed]
lines.caption: Appointment types and statuses are color-coded, so I can read the day at a glance.

lines.spoken: And if someone misses a visit, the No Show list makes the follow-up easy.
lines.caption: And if someone misses a visit, the No Show list makes the follow-up easy.
lines.tip: Phone numbers are right there for quick follow-up.

lines.spoken: Agenda is my favorite Calendar View. It shows every patient, and exactly where they are in the clinic.
lines.caption: Agenda is my favorite Calendar View. It shows every patient, and exactly where they are in the clinic.

lines.spoken: Jordan just walked in. Go ahead: drag Jordan's card over to Arrived.
lines.caption: Jordan just walked in. Go ahead: drag Jordan's card over to Arrived.

lines.spoken: That's it. Everyone in the office sees it instantly.
lines.caption: That's it. Everyone in the office sees it instantly.

lines.spoken: Every clinic runs a little differently, so you can rename and rearrange these columns to fit yours.
lines.caption: Every clinic runs a little differently, so you can rename and rearrange these columns to fit yours.

lines.spoken: Thanks Autumn! I use this screen too. One click on Incomplete Notes, and I see every visit I still need to finish, before I head home.
lines.caption: Thanks Autumn! I use this screen too. One click on Incomplete Notes, and I see every visit I still need to finish, before I head home.

lines.spoken: Let's head to my side of the clinic. Our new patient, Jordan, booked online and filled out her paperwork from home, so her chart is ready before she walks in.
lines.caption: Let's head to my side of the clinic. Our new patient, Jordan, booked online and filled out her paperwork from home, so her chart is ready before she walks in.

lines.spoken: Jordan's first note is already waiting, built from the intake. Low back pain, right there.
lines.caption: Jordan's first note is already waiting, built from the intake. Low back pain, right there.

lines.spoken: I load my low-back template, and my usual findings fill in. I only change what's different today.
lines.caption: I load my low-back template, and my usual findings fill in. I only change what's different today.

lines.spoken: Findings only take a few clicks: what I found, where I found it, and how severe it was.
lines.caption: Findings only take a few clicks: what I found, where I found it, and how severe it was.
lines.tip: Templates and macros built for chiropractic.

lines.spoken: Turncloud is built by people who know chiropractic notes. A new-patient exam, done in minutes.
lines.caption: Turncloud is built by people who know chiropractic notes. A new-patient exam, done in minutes.

lines.spoken: Now watch this. Chiroglyphix, our AI, takes everything I just entered and writes the note for me.
lines.caption: Now watch this. Chiroglyphix, our AI, takes everything I just entered and writes the note for me.

lines.spoken: Your turn. Click Generate.
lines.caption: Your turn. Click Generate.

lines.spoken: A complete SOAP note, in seconds. On my letterhead, ready to sign.
lines.caption: A complete SOAP note, in seconds. On my letterhead, ready to sign.

lines.spoken: I maintain complete control over the final note, with the ability to review, edit, and approve every word. [Proud]
lines.caption: I maintain complete control over the final note, with the ability to review, edit, and approve every word.

lines.spoken: That's how charting stops being your evening job.
lines.caption: That's how charting stops being your evening job.

lines.spoken: Jordan will need a few weeks of care, so I put her on a twelve-visit plan.
lines.caption: Jordan will need a few weeks of care, so I put her on a twelve-visit plan.

lines.spoken: Click Jordan's plan to open it.
lines.caption: Click Jordan's plan to open it.

lines.spoken: Turncloud tracks every phase of care and every visit. Jordan's on visit one of twelve, and I can see exactly what comes next.
lines.caption: Turncloud tracks every phase of care and every visit. Jordan's on visit one of twelve, and I can see exactly what comes next.

lines.spoken: And here's every patient on a plan, in one place: visits planned, and visits done.
lines.caption: And here's every patient on a plan, in one place: visits planned, and visits done.
lines.tip: Every patient's progress at a glance.

lines.spoken: Care plans stay on track, without anyone tracking them by hand.
lines.caption: Care plans stay on track, without anyone tracking them by hand.

lines.spoken: [happy] By the time Jordan gets to my desk, the charges are already here, posted straight from Dr. Davis's note.
lines.caption: By the time Jordan gets to my desk, the charges are already here, posted straight from Dr. Davis's note.

lines.spoken: [Proud] I take the co-pay, and Jordan's insurance is already filled in from the intake.
lines.caption: I take the co-pay, and Jordan's insurance is already filled in from the intake.

lines.spoken: With Automatic Billing the claims take care of themselves. Every night, Turncloud gathers the day's claims and sends them out.
lines.caption: With Automatic Billing the claims take care of themselves. Every night, Turncloud gathers the day's claims and sends them out.

lines.spoken: If something's missing, like a date of birth, it flags it first, so I can fix it before the claim goes out.
lines.caption: If something's missing, like a date of birth, it flags it first, so I can fix it before the claim goes out.
lines.tip: Problems caught before claims go out.

lines.spoken: So billing doesn't fall behind, even on our busiest days.
lines.caption: So billing doesn't fall behind, even on our busiest days.

lines.spoken: When insurance pays, I import the ERA, and the payments post to every patient's account at once.
lines.caption: When insurance pays, I import the ERA, and the payments post to every patient's account at once.

lines.spoken: I can review anything before I finalize including Insurance payments posted on autopilot.
lines.caption: I can review anything before I finalize including Insurance payments posted on autopilot.

lines.spoken: At the end of the day, here's how we did: patients seen, charges, and payments, by provider.
lines.caption: At the end of the day, here's how we did: patients seen, charges, and payments, by provider.

lines.spoken: Need more? Choose the report that gives you what you want. The daysheet shows every patient we saw today, what we billed, what we collected, and whether everything balances.
lines.caption: Need more? Choose the report that gives you what you want. The daysheet shows every patient we saw today, what we billed, what we collected, and whether everything balances.

lines.spoken: Outstanding claims shows what insurance still owes us, and flags any claim that's been denied or stalled, with the fix right there.
lines.caption: Outstanding claims shows what insurance still owes us, and flags any claim that's been denied or stalled, with the fix right there.

lines.spoken: And accounts receivable shows every dollar we're owed, by insurance and by patient, and how long it's been sitting there.
lines.caption: And accounts receivable shows every dollar we're owed, by insurance and by patient, and how long it's been sitting there.

lines.spoken: And since it's all in the cloud, I can check it from home, or anywhere.
lines.caption: And since it's all in the cloud, I can check it from home, or anywhere.

lines.spoken: So that's Jordan's first visit: booked, checked in, treated, charted, and billed. Patient in, patient out.
lines.caption: So that's Jordan's first visit: booked, checked in, treated, charted, and billed. Patient in, patient out.
